admitBaselinePair mandates a complementary paired fixture with byte-identical canonicalInputBytes whenever baselineRole is WITH or WITHOUT, and fails closed with named tokens (MISSING_PAIR, SAME_ROLE_PAIR, MALFORMED_ROLE, NONEQUIVALENT_INPUT_BYTES, UNEXPECTED_PAIR_FOR_NONE_ROLE) on any structural defect; its own claim boundary states this is a pure structural admission check that does not grade either fixture and does not imply PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE. Hash matches G3 T2 completion review's cited final SHA-256 exactly, confirming the accepted closed version was read.

G1 design explicitly defers G4 throughout: 'G4 (marginal/incremental value measurement) is excluded and deferred throughout. No G4 output, score, or ratio is computed or consumed here.' Notes G4 could later consume OperatingPointAssessment/RegressionBinding pairs as WITH/WITHOUT evidence but creates no interface, hook, or promise toward that. This file's own self-declared Status header still reads COMPLETE_PENDING_REVIEW/DESIGN_READY_FOR_SEPARATE_IMPLEMENTATION_WORK_ORDER because it predates Local's R1 repair pass; current session/handoff authority records the design as CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED at material commit d87aadaec (not yet implemented as an owner contract).

W93-T1 (section 8) requires comparing same task, same provider, same model family, same template, with only one controlled variable changed (with/without knowledge-native support), over a frozen 4-template evaluation set, ending in exactly one of three named outcome tokens (PROVEN / NOT PROVEN yet / MIXED), supported by rubric deltas and evidence excerpts, not narrative preference. Scoped to the non-coder value wave (W90-W94) only; not a general-purpose CVF value-delta mechanism.

comparisonAdmissionContract.baselineAndCandidateIdentity: stable immutable baselineId/candidateId bound to G3 baselineRole WITHOUT/WITH fixtures respectively; a baselineRole NONE fixture cannot participate in a G4 comparison
comparisonAdmissionContract.frozenTaskPopulation: identical fixtureSetContentHash required on both sides, mirroring G3's byte-identical canonicalInputBytes pairing rule extended to the population level
comparisonAdmissionContract.candidateTraceEvaluationLinkage: each side supplies {baselineOrCandidateId, fixtureId, fixtureContentHash, traceIds, traceContentHashes, traceCaptureModes, g3ResultHash, producerReceiptRef}; decision layer verifies against supplied G3 outputs and a producer receipt tying each trace to its declared side
comparisonAdmissionContract.interventionVariableRule: each round declares exactly one interventionVariable (e.g. PROVIDER_LANE, CAPABILITY_CHANGE, DELEGATION_DECISION, TOPOLOGY_CHANGE); its identity is in comparabilityFingerprint, while its distinct baseline/candidate content-hashed values are provenance-bound and excluded from held-fixed equality. Missing declaration or value binding with two sides is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; identical values are INCOMPARABLE. Pairing alone does not prove causal attribution.
heldFixedConditions: providerLane (held fixed only when interventionVariable != PROVIDER_LANE)
comparisonAdmissionContract.multipleUncontrolledVariablesRule: a round that varies more than one dimension at once (the declared intervention variable plus any other dimension) is INCOMPARABLE with reason MULTIPLE_UNCONTROLLED_VARIABLES
comparisonAdmissionContract.outcomeDimensionRule: each declared metric carries an explicit name, unit, and direction declared before measurement, never inferred after seeing results
comparisonAdmissionContract.reviewCostUsageRule: review-cost counters may populate only the disclosed resource dimension of an already-classified round; they can never by themselves establish a classification
comparisonAdmissionContract.pairedAggregationRule: aggregates only over the intersection of admitted fixture IDs on both sides, subject to a predeclared immutable minimum intersection-coverage threshold with 0 < minimum <= 1; missing/out-of-range declaration is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, nonempty below-threshold intersection is INCOMPARABLE (INTERSECTION_BELOW_DECLARED_MINIMUM), empty intersection is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (EMPTY_INTERSECTION); these are admission checks before terminal delta classification; asymmetric members are disclosed by side
comparisonAdmissionContract.uncertaintyDisclosureRule: discloses only descriptive repeat counts (G3's repeatsObserved/repeatsRequired per fixture) for STOCHASTIC fixtures; no statistical confidence-interval or variance-estimation method is defined by this design, and no numeric confidence figure may be reported until a future tranche defines and cites one
comparisonAdmissionContract.missingPartialEvidenceRule: reused directly from G1's search/held-out separation; a fixture exposed to candidate tuning before the round cannot supply accepted evidence for that round
comparisonAdmissionContract.selectionBiasHoldoutLeakageRule: REUSED_HELDOUT_SEARCH_DATA-shaped rejection reused from G1 for any fixture ID/canonical-input-hash/source-hash overlap with a declared search/tuning set
comparisonAdmissionContract.noEffectNegativeEffectRule: explicitly first-class output states; never silently folded into a generic PASS or omitted
comparisonAdmissionContract.tieIncomparabilityRule: equal observed outcomes are reported as zero/near-zero under the otherwise admissible classification, never implicit preference, statistical significance, or causal effect

classificationStates.meaning: both sides are admitted G3 WITH/WITHOUT pairs under one matching comparabilityFingerprint, complete bound evidence, predeclared metric/unit/direction; aggregated observed difference and descriptive repeat counts reported, without causal or numeric confidence claim
comparable evidence exists but was not produced under a controlled, admitted G3 WITH/WITHOUT design; description only, never a causal claim

different comparabilityFingerprint, a held-fixed dimension varies, multiple dimensions vary at once (MULTIPLE_UNCONTROLLED_VARIABLES), or intersection coverage is below the declared minimum (INTERSECTION_BELOW_DECLARED_MINIMUM); never merged or scored

missing/ambiguous binding, unadmitted or contaminated holdout, incomplete G3 trace/repeat evidence, REUSED_HELDOUT_SEARCH_DATA contamination on either side, or an empty fixture intersection (EMPTY_INTERSECTION)

no comparison attempted or no second (baseline or candidate) side exists at all; tests absence of a second side only, never pairing quality; must never be silently reported as a delta state, and a genuine complete two-sided uncontrolled comparison is DESCRIPTIVE_NONCAUSAL_DELTA, not this state

classificationPrecedence: stage1: no second (baseline or candidate) side exists at all -> NO_MEASUREMENT

stage2: both sides exist but held-fixed conditions mismatch, multiple dimensions vary, intervention values are identical, or a nonempty fixture intersection is below the predeclared minimum -> INCOMPARABLE

stage3: both sides exist and are otherwise comparable but intervention/value/coverage declaration, binding, admission, or trace/repeat evidence is missing/ambiguous/contaminated, or the fixture intersection is empty -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
stage4: both sides exist, are comparable, and are complete, but the pairing was not produced under an admitted G3 WITH/WITHOUT design -> DESCRIPTIVE_NONCAUSAL_DELTA
stage5: both sides exist, are comparable, are complete, and were produced under an admitted G3 WITH/WITHOUT pairing with predeclared metric/unit/direction -> MEASURED_COMPARABLE_DELTA
no stage may be skipped and no later stage overturns an earlier stage's classification
